actualPath.entry: createWorld/replaceWorldMap -> prepareVillageStart -> loadVillage/loadStreamedVillage -> readMapContainer -> Babylon EXT_meshopt_compression -> cacheMapBufferViews -> local real Meshopt WASM adapter
actualPath.release: world.releaseEnvironment -> streaming/texture stop -> in-flight owned LOD drain -> source/archive/instance/material/observer disposal -> replaceWorldMap
actualPath.wrapperNames: HEAD4c5de0c has no standalone loadWorldEnvironment/releaseWorldEnvironment functions. Tests follow the actual names above.
actualPath.differenceFromEarlierCoverage: Compressed shipped glTF bufferViews remain intact. Earlier geometry lifecycle tests decoded buffers before Babylon loading and therefore skipped its EXT/runtime decode cache path.

normalTrips.byteEquivalentWarmGeometry: Indices/POSITION/NORMAL/UV hashes match every repeat of each actual glTF. Public model and buffer filenames are verified against SHA256.

lateCompletionCases.mapRelease: Pause a real EXT decoder promise for an unvisited cave eroded-wall midLOD. Release waits; after controlled completion, the old container is disposed without installation, pending0, and forest initial load succeeds.
lateCompletionCases.cachePolicy: Completed old-map bytes may enter the detached bounded CPU cache for warm reuse. This is intentional and does not retain a scene/GPU owner.
lateCompletionCases.engineDispose: Dispose engine during actual EXT decode, then allow completion. Pool stays disposed with geometry/texture cache bytes0, no late world ownership or scene render observer remains.
lateCompletionCases.limit: A geometry decoder which permanently never resolves remains an unbounded release dependency in this design. Controlled-late completion passing does not prove such a driver/worker stall cannot happen. No unreviewed timeout/forced termination was added.

fixtureCorrections: setTarget changes orbit angles, so canonical arrival alpha/beta/radius are fixed before comparing startup plans.
Babylon's one scene OutlineRenderer is explicitly warmed before baselines; its one-time stage is not counted as per-map growth.

Observable.remove marks _willBeUnregistered immediately but removes array entries on a timer. Inspection confirmed active callbacks unchanged; await a timer turn before comparing raw observer arrays, rather than misreport setImmediate ordering as a leak.

NullEngine has no GPU RawTexture upload. Scene-owned RawTextures are marked ready at the explicit upload boundary before readiness checks, including a fallback created by the first draw. This is a test boundary, not a production change.
limits: Actual geometry and cache verification; image decode/transcode and image GPU memory are excluded.
The real WASM decoder runs via a local in-process test adapter; browser worker scheduling, context restoration and driver behavior are not measured.

Player8K manifest is checked and retained player-anchor identity is exercised. The full player image allocation, boss/transform lifecycle, portal input and UI are the parent agent's independent scope.
Stable object counts are not a process heap/RSS/VRAM measurement and do not establish phone thermals or FPS.
Warmer cache removes repeat geometry decoding; AssetContainer import, setup and image/GPU work can still take time. No phone loading-speed improvement is inferred from this fixture.
